name: Terrorweb Tunnel
summary: Crypt fiends swarm through Terrorweb Tunnel, the mountain way between Terrordale and the Thondroril River.

sections.title: A Subterranean Infestation
sections.body: Terrorweb Tunnel cuts through the mountains beside the Thondroril River. It runs from Terrordale to the riverbanks south of the village. Crypt fiends fill the passage where ghouls or skeletal sentries might be found. These mummified nerubian arachnids were raised to serve the Lich King. The tunnel shortens the route around the mountain slopes, but thick webs and towering Nerubian Overseers make the dark way dangerous to cross.

faq.answer: Terrorweb Tunnel cuts through the mountain range northwest of Terrordale. Its northern entrance opens into Terrordale, and its southern mouth reaches the rocky banks overlooking the Thondroril River.
Crypt fiends swarm through Terrorweb Tunnel. These undead nerubian spider-lords came from ancient Northrend. Formidable Nerubian Overseers also stalk the passages, making travel dangerous.

faq.q: Who is nearby outside the tunnel?
faq.answer: The exiled paladin Tirion Fordring keeps a modest campsite along the Thondroril River, near Terrorweb Tunnel’s southern mouth.

faq.q: Why are nerubians in the Plaguelands?
faq.answer: The Lich King conquered Azjol-Nerub, the subterranean kingdom in Northrend, and reanimated fallen nerubians as crypt fiends. When the Scourge invaded Lordaeron, these arachnid shock troops went south to enforce the Cult of the Damned’s grip on the region.

angles.text: As a paladin, you can find the exiled Tirion Fordring near Terrorweb Tunnel’s southern mouth. He keeps a modest campsite along the Thondroril River.
